title: loheria reiniana
intro: Loheria reiniana, commonly known as Chinese angelica, is a perennial plant native to the mountainous regions of China. It has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, offering numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiviral properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Loheria reiniana are attributed to its ability to regulate the body's energy and balance its yin and yang, as well as its anti-bacterial and anti-fungal properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ligustilide, senkyunolide, and butylphthalide, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
